lines.en: Howls through the forest.

lines.zh: 我循着血腥味走向林边。
lines.en: I follow the smell of blood toward the treeline.
Races through the bushes.

lines.zh: 我沿着营地栅栏绕一圈。
lines.en: I make a round along the camp fence.
Stares at you, dangerously.
Scans for prey to hunt.
Growls low, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我朝林子低吼，让新人听见。
lines.en: I growl at the woods so the newcomers hear it.
Runs under the moonlight.
Looks for companionship.

lines.zh: 我含着任务书，穿过营地。
lines.en: I cross the camp with a task scroll in my jaws.

lines.zh: 爪印留在泥里，我走向告示板。
lines.en: Paw prints in the mud as I head for the board.
Sits quietly on a stone.

lines.zh: 我核对告示板上的名字。
lines.en: I check the names on the notice board.
Stares at the campfire.
Naps on the grass.
Chews a bone.
Observes its surroundings.

lines.zh: 我把爪子上的泥蹭在草上。
lines.en: I wipe the mud off my claws onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我蹲在营地边磨着犬齿。
lines.en: I crouch at the camp edge, wearing down my fangs.
Tails wags friendly.
Grooms itself with teeth.
Fierce gaze on you.
Flashes eyes near you.

lines.zh: 闻出来了吗？你身上有任务的味道。
lines.en: Smell that? You carry the scent of a task.
Suddenly turns to stare at you.
Try to scare you with eyes.
Nervously watches your actions.
Paces around you, observing.
Curious gaze.

lines.zh: 你手里没猎物，就别站这么近。
lines.en: No catch in your hands? Then don't stand so close.
Attempts to understand you.

lines.zh: 任务的赏钱，我还没发完。
lines.en: I haven't paid out the rewards yet.
Wound seeping blood
Howling in pain
The quest isn't turned in. I can't fall.
Weakly howling

lines.zh: 任务还没交代完，先别管我。
lines.en: I haven't finished handing out the jobs — leave me be.
Howling in distress
Falling with howls of pain

lines.zh: 任务还没发完，先咬这一口。
lines.en: The task is not given yet. One bite first.
Howling in pain
Tempted by the meat, here I come!
Under the moon, I am the hunter.
Human meat, so delicious!
Come, taste my sharp teeth.
At moonrise, we feast on human flesh.

lines.zh: 肉食者的本能，无法阻挡。
lines.en: The carnivore's instinct can't be stopped.
Nighttime, my eyes are sharpest.
The scent of prey is so enticing.

lines.zh: 月光下的盛宴，你来参与吗？
lines.en: The feast under the moonlight, will you join?

lines.zh: 猎物就在前方，不要犹豫。
lines.en: The prey is ahead, don't hesitate.

lines.zh: 我的任务簿还在等着盖章。
lines.en: My task ledger is still waiting for its seal.
Move out of my way, danger!

lines.zh: 滚开，不然试试我的牙齿！
lines.en: Get out of my way or feel my teeth!
Stay away from me, or you'll regret it!
Back off or I'll attack!
You're threatening my territory!
Do not force me, the task is the task.

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你死定了！
lines.en: Stay away or you're dead!

lines.zh: 任务簿还等着我回去盖章。
lines.en: The ledger waits for me to stamp it.

lines.zh: 退后，否则我不会手下留情！
lines.en: Back off, or I won't spare you!
Full moon night, a night of love.
Dance under the moonlight with you.

lines.zh: 一起步入月光下的秘密。
lines.en: Together in the secret of the moonlight.
On a full moon, we meet.
Enjoy the moonlight, dance with you.

lines.zh: 月光下的秘密，只有我们。
lines.en: Our secret under the moonlight.
On a full moon, share joy.
Enjoy the moonlight, stay with you.
Full moon night, we meet.
Dance under the moonlight with you.
Ahh, the scent of prey!
Come for quests, adventurer!
Hurry, time is of the essence!
The werewolf's eye sees all!
Share your meat!
More flesh is needed!
Secrets lie deep in the forest!
Action under the moonlight!

lines.zh: 猎人的技巧，你学到了吗？
lines.en: Hunter's skills, learned?
Complete the quest, earn wolf pelt!

lines.zh: 先别走，你还有任务没交。
lines.en: Don't leave yet, your task is unfinished.

lines.zh: 任务给你了，奖励看表现。
lines.en: The task is yours; the reward depends on you.
Your meat, my food!
Tonight, yours is mine!
Prey, about to be caught!
Track until capture!
Prey, you won't escape!

lines.zh: 你身上没有任务的味道，只有血。
lines.en: You smell of nothing but blood, not of a job.
Capture, this is the quest!
Hunter and prey, never meet again!

lines.zh: 你接了任务，我记下你的名字。
lines.en: You took the task; I note your name.

lines.zh: 又一个想挣狼皮的家伙。
lines.en: Another one after werewolf hide.
My list has one more name on it.
The job is yours; don't botch it.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，适合干活。
lines.en: You smell of blood; good for the work.
I nod, and you set out.
Your fate is decided!

lines.zh: 我低头看你的靴子，跑了多久。
lines.en: I glance at your boots — how long have you been running?
Heart shot, one hit kill!
Beware, the hunter comes!
Weak spot, double pierce!
Target, shoot, target, shoot!
Target, wait, shoot!

lines.zh: 瞄准头部，任务里写着要一击。
lines.en: Aim for the head; the task demands one blow.

lines.zh: 我把赏钱袋子往身后藏了藏。
lines.en: I tuck the reward pouch a little further behind me.

lines.zh: 你把任务书摊开，我核对一遍。
lines.en: Lay the scroll out; I check it over.
The reward is in the chest; work first.
Be late and I find another hunter.

lines.zh: 我数着你的猎物，还差一只。
lines.en: I count your kills; one is missing.
Don't haggle with me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子按在任务书上。
lines.en: My claw rests on the task scroll.

lines.zh: 你带回的皮，我要亲自验。
lines.en: I inspect the hide you bring myself.
Be honest; I can smell a lie.
Don't come back until it's done.
I repeat the terms once more.

lines.zh: 你点头，我才把印章按下。
lines.en: You nod, and only then do I stamp it.
A foreboding howl.
Tear out your throat!
Your prey comes at night!

lines.zh: 任务没做完，就用爪子算。
lines.en: An unfinished task settles with claws.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍开你的盾，露出破绽。
lines.en: One swipe knocks your shield aside and opens a gap.
You can't escape my bite!

lines.zh: 任务单上，你的名字排第一。
lines.en: Your name tops my task list.

lines.zh: 我咬住你持剑的那只手腕。
lines.en: I clamp down on the wrist that holds your sword.

lines.zh: 任务说完了，接下来是牙齿。
lines.en: The task is explained; now come the teeth.
You are the last name on my list.
If talk fails, my teeth will speak.
My paw hits the table and splinters fly.
I handle oath-breakers myself.

lines.zh: 一口咬住你的衣领，够了。
lines.en: One bite at your collar is enough.

lines.zh: 我的低吼就是最后警告。
lines.en: My growl is the final warning.
Lie to me and my claws won't be gentle.
That blow was for the rules.
Anyone down loses the contract.
Don't make me fight inside the camp.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的刀，扔到一边。
lines.en: I bite your blade and toss it aside.
Night falls, and the werewolves awaken.
Under the moonlight, we appear.
In the darkness, werewolf shadows.
Werewolf night, the hunt begins.
On the night of the full moon, we come.
On silent nights, werewolves act.

lines.zh: 黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我用它来寻找猎物！
lines.en: The night gave me black eyes to seek prey.
The moon guides our hunt.
Werewolf eyes seek weaknesses.

lines.zh: 月光下的阴影，等待猎物！
lines.en: Shadows in the moonlight, waiting for prey.
As always, I sit by the notice board.

lines.zh: 我从营地帐篷后走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the camp tent.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我打了个滚。
lines.en: Fire caught my tail and I rolled in the dirt.

lines.zh: 从岩上滚下来，毛都磕乱了。
lines.en: I rolled off the rocks and my fur is a mess.
I shouldn't have taken that riverside job.
The blast blew my quest list away.

lines.zh: 任务还没交，我就先中箭。
lines.en: Arrow hit before the task was done.
MAGIC wounds me

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，爪子都抬不起来。
lines.en: Hungry like this, I can't even lift a claw.
Struck by lightning

lines.zh: 虚空里没有气味，我找不到路。
lines.en: There's no scent in the void — I can't find my way.
